description: This file defines the internal readonly struct 'StateEntity' used for managing transaction state data within Azure Table Storage in the Orleans framework. It includes methods for creating, serializing, deserializing, and splitting large JSON state data into table properties, along with constants and helper functions for data size management.

classes.name: StateEntity
classes.description: A struct representing a transaction state entity stored in Azure Table Storage, with methods for serialization, deserialization, and managing large JSON state data across multiple table properties.

methods.name: MakeRowKey
methods.description: Generates a row key string based on a sequence ID, formatted as a hexadecimal string with a prefix.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new StateEntity instance from a pending transaction state, serializing relevant properties.

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: Deserializes the stored JSON state data into an object of type T.

methods.name: SetState
methods.description: Serializes a state object into JSON and stores it internally.

methods.name: SetStateInternal
methods.description: Splits large JSON string data into multiple table properties, ensuring size constraints.

methods.name: GetStateInternal
methods.description: Concatenates stored string chunks from table properties into a single JSON string.

methods.name: GetPropertyOrDefault
methods.description: Retrieves a property value from the TableEntity or returns null if not present.

methods.name: CheckMaxDataSize
methods.description: Validates that data size does not exceed maximum allowed size, throws exception if it does.

methods.name: GetPropertyNames
methods.description: Generates the list of property names used to store string chunks of state data.
